prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE environment concept-art VALUE-THUMBNAIL CONTACT SHEET, six distinct rough composition proposals for the cozy third-person game "Weather House".
Primary request: a professional environment designer's early BLACK / GRAY / WHITE massing studies, before any color development. Start from a blank canvas and genuinely explore SIX DIFFERENT compositions of the SAME place. This is a review board for selecting a composition. Keep it very rough, flat, bold, sparse and graphic.
Layout: exactly six equal wide landscape thumbnails in a clean 3-column by 2-row grid, with plain white gutters, simple small black labels A, B, C, D, E, F in the margin of each panel. Each panel should be wide about 16:9. Overall sheet very wide, approximately 2.5:1. No other lettering.
World / consistent subject: a cozy small weather witch's cottage at the edge of a forest, one distinctive oversize old tree, a curving walkable path, a small pond nearby and gentle hills. Cottage is modest and storybook: steep slightly crooked roof, squat plaster body and small porch. Show a tiny 3.5-head-tall witch in a floppy hat holding a short wooden wand as a simple scale silhouette. Rounded friendly forms. Natural animal homes may be indicated by a single tree hollow shape. No village, cathedral, giant castle, or monumental ruins.
Rendering discipline: use ONLY FOUR discrete grayscale values: near black, dark middle gray, light middle gray, near white. Large interlocking opaque brush shapes. Each tree canopy is one shape; each roof is one shape; each ground plane is a broad shape. Shadows join into coherent masses. A handful of decisive rectangular or wedge-shaped brush marks, slight rough edges. Preserve large absolutely quiet untextured areas. Readable at postage-stamp size. No smooth gradients, realistic illumination, surface texture, grass blades, individual leaves, flowers, bark striations, tiles, line hatching, detailed windows, costumes or faces. Not pencil line drawings. Not detailed grayscale renders. Not six polished illustrations. Think 5-minute composition notans / value block-ins painted with a broad brush. The simplicity of a paper-cut composition with the irregularity of a rough paint sketch. Flat graphic light and shadow, with depth coming only from overlap, scale and value grouping.
Six genuinely distinct compositional ideas:
A, top left: eye-level approach. Heavy dark tree shapes make an arch at the sides and top, a broad light opening holds the small cottage on the right third, the pale path bends from lower left. Strong dark-frame/light-center structure, pond just suggested by a pale sliver.
B, top middle: open rolling hillside with cottage on left third and low horizon. A large diagonal hill sweeps lower left to upper right; old tree beside the house; expansive near-white sky and two broad flat cloud shapes occupy upper half. Airy and peaceful, minimal forest framing.
C, top right: low view across a foreground pond. The water is one large near-white horizontal shape, the cottage and tree form a single dark connected island mass at the far right bank, two simple reflection marks, a tiny witch on the nearer bank. Clear horizontal composition.
D, bottom left: intimate courtyard. One great tree trunk and its sweeping canopy dominate left two thirds, a tiny light cottage nestles at its base on the right, an oval patch of light links the entrance to the tiny witch in the foreground. Strong oversized tree versus small house silhouette, gentle storybook proportions.
E, bottom middle: path curves through two zones: dark cloud-shadowed tree foreground at left, a clear light sunny patch around cottage at right. A small floating rain cloud and a few vertical rain marks sit over a simple moss-bed shape near the path; drying rack is only two posts and one bar on sunny side. Demonstrate local-weather story using broad connected light/dark areas. Use only a few objects so it remains a primitive value sketch.
F, bottom right: slightly elevated view from a grassy bank. A dark simple witch silhouette and plain wooden wind-chime frame at lower right look down toward a middle-distance cottage at left, a light S-shaped path connects the house to a small light pond on right. Old tree is beside the house. Layered foreground/midground/background bands with a quiet hill silhouette.
Constraints: entirely neutral monochrome, zero color, no sepia. Six different layouts, not six copies or lighting variants of one layout. Each stays charming and inviting even in grayscale. No cinematic realism, lens effects, ambient occlusion, polished shading, 3D appearance, ornate props, texture brushes or microdetail. No named artist imitation. No watermark.
